General 

General 

    

PRAGATI BHARATE  
 Email : pragatibharate7@gmail.com    Mobile : +91-7709763434 

 

 

To work with an organization where can learn new skills and increase my abilities for the organization goal as well 

as myself. 

 
 

EDUCATION    

   
    

Fergusson College(Autonomous), Pune                                                                                                           CGPA : 8 

M.Sc. Computer Application, From September 2022 - 2024     

Vidya Pratishthan's Arts, Science and Commerce College, Baramati                                                        Percentage: 89.86 % 

B.Sc. Computer Science, From June 2019 - 2022              

 
 

EXPERIENCE    

   
 

Tech Support Engineer| Tech Mahindra| India | July 2024- Present 

• Collaboration with Stakeholders: Collaborated on the Openreach project, directly interfacing with UK clients 

to address technical needs. 

 

• Requirements Gathering: Gather requirements like NSI, R-code and port information for sync checks as well as 

toggle requests and T-code and CBT codes for SASA information.  

 

• Business Intelligence gathering: Provided expert guidance to engineers on technical issues across multiple 

server platforms, including Nokia, ADTRAN, and Huawei.  

 

• Performance: Diagnosed and resolved server-specific problems by gathering and analysing relevant technical 

information. 

 

  Intern | PSPM Technology Pvt. Ltd| India | February 2024 – June 2024    

• Assignment on HTML and CSS: Created different webpages.  

• Assignment on MySQL: Creation of database, Performed CRUD and Joins operations  

• Basic Sessions/Training: Training on Python and Lang Chain  

• Ensured quality and performance of web applications and backend systems. Also conducted functional, regression, 

and performance testing to maintain system integrity. 

• Created detailed test cases to cover all application functionalities and focused on delivering a seamless user 

experience and optimizing application performance. 

 
 



 

 

General 

General 

TECHNICAL SKILLS     

   
• BI Technologies: Microsoft Power BI (Aggregate, Date, Logical, String, Table), Excel, Data visualization, Data 

Modelling, BI Gateways, ETL. 
 

• Relational Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL 
 

• Languages: Python, Java, C language, SQL, HTML, CSS 
 

• Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Agile Methodology, Data Modelling, Process Mapping, SWOT 
Analysis, Agile & Scrum, Cost-Benefit Analysis, manual testing. 

 
• Soft skills: Communication, Adaptability, Problem Solving, Teamwork, Collaboration, Time management. 

 

 

PROJECTS    

     

PMT (Pune Municipal Transport) Pass System | Java (JSP), HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PostgreSQL, XAMPP  

 

• web-based tool which helps people renew and register for new bus passes online.  

• Provide commuters with versatile pass options tailored to their travel frequency, encouraging regular usage of 

public transportation while simplifying payment methods. 

 

 

    

Maharashtra Tourist Guide | HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript, PostgreSQL 

 

• It is a web-based software system which allows users to discover and explore new places according to their choice. 

• Users can also see photographs and information of the places and its surroundings to get conception of the places 

even before visiting it. 

• Users can also book railway, bus and airline tickets through our software system. 

• The main objective of this project is to make travel easy and comfortable for the users right from finding the best 

places to booking tickets.    

      

   Student Management System| HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript, PostgreSQL 

 

• Designed a web-based software system for both college and student. Used by educational institutions to 

maintain their student's record and provide the notices. 

• Multiple user roles (admin, student, etc.), and each user has different functionality. 

• It includes processes like registration of the students' details, assigning all departments based on their course 

and management of the records. 

• This system reduces the time and workforce required for this job. 

• As the system is online, the information is locally present to everyone. 
 

 

CERTIFICATES

   
 

• C language by IIT Bombay  

• Basic Python certificate by net2net knowledge solutions (07/2021 - 09/2021)
